description:
Builds backend/registry/country_terms.json (30 Oct 2026, approved experiment).

Country-specific tax forms, returns, schemes, charges and identifiers, each
mapped to ONE country, with the authority that issues or administers it and
the official source it is listed on. Built per country from the authority's own
categories (individual return, company return, indirect-tax return, payroll and
withholding forms, identifiers, distinctive schemes and charges), BEFORE set 11
was written, and frozen by hash. Version 2 (31 Oct 2026): each phrase carries its live verification (authority page URL, time, content hash, quote) or
status unverified; 48 direct page reads, no model; version 3 adds 13 India reads (cbic-gst.gov.in, incometax.gov.in).

Terms used by more than one country, or with a common non-tax meaning, are
listed under "ambiguous" and never map. Matching is on whole words;
"case_sensitive" acronyms match only in capitals ("BAS", not "bas").
